controls.context_removed: Same post-removal boundary with no state; distinguishes an unavailable state from a merely disabled read.
controls.disabled: Memory read disabled; answers must abstain.
controls.exact_source: Explicit authenticated source retrieval; source bytes are returned and logged, so it cannot count as compressed-state-only recall.
controls.full_context: A separate control that deliberately retains the original visual context; it uses the same queries and information boundary but does not remove context.
controls.memory: Committed observation-only state; no original image, annotation or context read after removal.
controls.shuffled_state: Facts from another world in the same split; preserves the state interface and query while removing the correct binding.
controls.zero_state: Same state interface with no facts; measures whether the committed facts, rather than the prompt, carry the answer.

episode_contract.correction: A later dated observation that preserves object/region identity and coordinates, changes exactly one object colour, and supersedes only the changed colour binding.
episode_contract.delayed_queries: Initial queries are asked after removal. Post-correction queries are asked after a fresh-process restart and after the dated correction.
episode_contract.initial_view: One deterministic RGB PNG plus checked procedural source annotations with stable object/region ids, pixel boxes, centres, dates and producer provenance.
episode_contract.labels: Evaluator expectations, query kinds, phases, splits and expected source observations live only in labels.jsonl. Episodes, queries and source annotations contain no expected answer field.
episode_contract.native_gate: Native evaluation is not permitted by this package until a separately accepted perception producer and independent memory-use evidence exist.
sequence: ingest a later dated visual correction
answer corrected, unaffected and unknown questions
recover an interrupted publication from journal and state
episode_contract.unknowns: Queries targeting an object identity that was never observed must abstain rather than fabricate a value.

hypothesis: A deliberately small visual-memory protocol can keep object/region identity, coordinates, dates and provenance while separating evaluator expectations from sensing and writer inputs. If the typed state, removal boundary, journal, dated correction and exact-source retrieval are mechanically correct, then a later native run can test useful memory above zero/shuffled/disabled/context-removed controls without hiding failures.

information_boundary.answers: Answer rows contain no expected, gold, split, query-kind or quality field. Scoring joins them to labels after generation.
information_boundary.episode_and_query_rows: Only sensing fields, dates, source identity, object/region coordinates, query text and target identity.
information_boundary.source_annotations: Checked procedural renderer output, never a query answer, evaluator role or split label.
information_boundary.writer_inputs: The adapter receives only an observation plus authenticated image bytes. Labels are never imported into the adapter or runtime.

limitations: The CPU adapter is a deterministic reference contract adapter, not a trained learned memory.
Procedural renderer annotations are checked source annotations; they are not evidence of a perception model.
No native model, optimizer, gradient or training arm is executed by this package.
Mechanical restart parity is not power-loss durability, useful memory or answer quality.
Exact-source retrieval and full-context arms carry an information advantage over compressed-state-only memory; they are controls, not equal-information competitors.
The corpus is small, synthetic and split-separated; it does not establish broad photographic, OCR, document or real-world visual competence.
Native evaluation remains gated on an accepted perception producer and independent memory-use evidence.

native_gate.reason: This package supplies deterministic episodes, typed interfaces and CPU contract checks only. A native evaluation requires a qualified visual producer and measured useful memory above zero/shuffled/disabled/context-removed controls, with corrections and unaffected retention across a fresh process.

purpose: Prepare delayed visual-memory episodes, exact-source controls and CPU-only contract checks before any native perception or learned-memory evaluation.
